results.name: storageAccount
results.reason: Learn selector/current page and pinned REST specifications establish current 2026-04-01 and latest GA 2026-09-01. Schemas confirms required location/sku/kind and networkAcls.defaultAction are supplied; all used literal enums/booleans and tags string-map contract match in both versions. Name route constraint is 3..24 lowercase alphanumeric; current defaults satisfy after normalization/truncation.
results.migration: GA移行可能。使用する全属性の型・enum・required契約は2026-04-01と2026-09-01で同一。2026-06/09の変更は未使用のSAS delegation/turbo tier/data-collaboration fields等。name式はappName/environmentのoverrideに無効文字がないことが条件。

findings.detail: 最新GA candidate 2026-09-01がcurrent 2026-04-01より新しい。全使用フィールドの契約は変わらず、追加/更新項目は今回未使用。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name maps to the REST path parameter accountName, not request-body JSON. Pinned current/GA OpenAPI requires 3–24 chars matching ^[a-z0-9]+$. Source storageAccountName uses lowercase, strips hyphens, appends 000, then takes 24 chars. Main defaults appName=aks-chaos-lab and environment=dev; unconstrained overrides containing other punctuation can violate the REST pattern.

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /location maps to required root request field location (string; supported registered geo-region). Module receives main location; root default is japaneast. Parameter overrides remain deployment input, not a payload-schema mismatch.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /tags maps to an object whose additionalProperties are strings. Main supplies {'azd-env-name': environment}, so this source value is a string-valued map; module's {} default is also valid.

usage.label: kind
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /kind maps to required root kind; literal 'StorageV2' is in current and candidate enum.

usage.label: sku
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku maps to required root Sku object. REST requires sku.name, supplied by nested usage.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku/name maps to required Sku.name; 'Standard_LRS' is in current and candidate enum.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties maps to StorageAccountPropertiesCreateParameters; each set member is checked below. No separate required property at this level.

usage.label: allowBlobPublicAccess
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/allowBlobPublicAccess maps to boolean; literal false is type-correct and explicitly disallows public blob/container access.

usage.label: allowSharedKeyAccess
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/allowSharedKeyAccess maps to boolean; literal false is type-correct and disables Shared Key authorization.

usage.label: minimumTlsVersion
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/minimumTlsVersion maps to enum [TLS1_0,TLS1_1,TLS1_2,TLS1_3]; 'TLS1_2' is supported. The spec notes TLS1_3 is not supported, and it is not used.

usage.label: networkAcls
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/networkAcls maps to NetworkRuleSet; REST requires defaultAction, supplied by its nested usage. bypass is optional.

usage.label: bypass
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/networkAcls/bypass maps to enum [None,Logging,Metrics,AzureServices]; literal 'None' is valid and bypasses none.

usage.label: defaultAction
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/networkAcls/defaultAction maps to required enum [Allow,Deny]; literal 'Deny' is valid and satisfies the nested required field.

usage.label: publicNetworkAccess
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/publicNetworkAccess maps to enum [Enabled,Disabled,SecuredByPerimeter]; literal 'Disabled' is supported.

usage.label: supportsHttpsTrafficOnly
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/supportsHttpsTrafficOnly maps to boolean; literal true is type-correct and permits HTTPS only.

usage.label: defaultToOAuthAuthentication
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/defaultToOAuthAuthentication maps to boolean; literal true is type-correct and selects OAuth as the default authentication.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 is the Bicep API type/version header, not REST JSON. Learn selector lists latest GA 2026-09-01; current is 2026-04-01.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/0 points to module/main location string parameter; main default japaneast is passed through to required REST location. The schema requires a supported region but no enum; no Azure query was performed.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/storageAccountName/$expression-line/0 points to derived resource identity. The expression concatenates normalizedStorageNameBase and 000, then take(...,24); name length is bounded above and the suffix keeps the default above the 3-character minimum.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/normalizedStorageNameBase/$expression-line/0 points to toLower(replace('st${appName}${environment}${resourceToken}', '-', '')). It lowercases and removes hyphens; appName/environment defaults are safe, but arbitrary overrides are not constrained to storage-name characters.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/appName/$expression-line/0 points to appName source (default 'aks-chaos-lab'; otherwise unconstrained string). It feeds the normalized storage account name; callers overriding it must avoid characters outside lowercase letters/digits/hyphens after normalization.

current.analysis: Learn current API page and pinned REST stable/2026-04-01/openapi.json were checked. Create body requires sku, kind, location; networkAcls requires defaultAction. Exact route accountName parameter is 3..24 and ^[a-z0-9]+$. All used literals and nested fields were resolved through Schemas.

ga.analysis: Learn latest selector lists 2026-09-01. Pinned REST stable/2026-09-01/openapi.json has identical constraints for every used field, name parameter, and required fields.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log: 2026-09 adds TurboTier/UserAssignedIdentityAutoGenerated and allowBlobAccessPoints, removes UserAssignedIdentity; 2026-06 adds SAS delegation fields; 2026-04 has no changes. These are unused by this declaration. uniqueString naming reference records its 13-character return.
